rows.label: bf02130100_0010
rows.name:
This whole thing with Core Crystals,
touching them to create Blades...

rows.label: bf02130100_0020
rows.name:
It's pretty amazing when
you think about it.

rows.label: bf02130100_0030
rows.name:
A Blade's true body is a gem-like element
called a Core Crystal.

rows.label: bf02130100_0040
rows.name:
Only when the one who touches it has aptitude
does it multiply its own body cells...

rows.label: bf02130100_0050
rows.name:
and create a separate
body. That is a Blade.

rows.label: bf02130100_0060
rows.name:
In other words, only when a Driver
and Core Crystal meet by fate...

rows.label: bf02130100_0080
rows.name:
That's so mysterious...
Why does that happen?

rows.label: bf02130100_0090
rows.name:
Now that is something no one knows.
It's just how it's always been.

rows.label: bf02130100_0100
rows.name:
Blades vary greatly in appearance. Some
resemble humans, while others resemble me.

rows.label: bf02130100_0110
rows.name:
There's a theory their appearance reflects
their Driver's personality and spirit.

rows.label: bf02130100_0120
rows.name:
The meeting of a Driver and Blade
is a very mysterious thing.
